title: Every drilling crew suffers equipment failure
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Every drilling crew suffers equipment failure, about recent at Skinwalker Ranch mesa, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: boring. We start drilling. Well, every drilling expert, and I'm talking every one of them that we brought out, has had dramatic equipment malfunction.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says his team has been drilling into a mesa on the land. He says every drilling expert they brought out had dramatic equipment failures. He tells it as a sign that something unusual sits under the ground there.
